_README: Constants for the RoSE co-sim throughput ablation. Every value carries a `source` and a `provenance` (the log/doc it came from). analyze.py merges these with the measured-NOW spike seam CSVs in ../run_out/ to emit results/ablation_results.csv. Do NOT hand-edit derived numbers here; put only anchors + model params.

model.tcyc_note: target cycles counted for effective_MHz (spin5e8 guest; dcyc=500001039 tcyc=827967947). effective_MHz = (tcyc/1e6)/wall_s.
model.compute_floor_note: free-running wall for the whole 827.968M-cycle workload => 59.9 MHz at FMR 1.0 (= the 60 MHz FPGA host clock). This is the irreducible sim-advance time; the barrier tax adds ON TOP of it.
model.warehouse_control_ticks_note: COMPUTED from two measured anchors: camera-free synced ceiling 24.6 MHz (wall 33.66 s) and live Isaac warehouse 16.2 MHz (wall 51.11 s) at 5M step / old socket => (51.11-33.66)/0.031 s-per-render = 563 control ticks. Used to fold env.step render cost into a run-level effective_MHz.

spike_old_socket.provenance: scratchpad/seam_decomposition.md (spike, PatternEnv, reqrsp guest, firesim_step=1000); superseded by measured-now run_out/seam_oldsock.csv

spike_new_socket.provenance: scratchpad/seam_decomposition.md POST-FIX (16-21 ms); superseded by measured-now run_out/seam_newsock.csv

fpga_new_socket.provenance: socket fix (send 105->6, spike-proven, identical host-Python mechanism) + FPGA freeze/MMIO-poll floor ~18 ms (unchanged); TO-BE-VERIFIED on FPGA

fpga_stepping_5M.provenance: 5M cyc / 60 MHz = 83 ms/grant FPGA sim-advance compute; already inside the 13.8 s compute floor (165.6 grants * 83 ms = 13.7 s)

render_every_step.provenance: camera_render_timing.md camera-ON (WarehouseThrustEnv, RTX every 200 Hz step, chase 960x540); ROSE_RENDER_HZ=0

render_lazy_10hz.provenance: camera_render_timing.md POST-FIX lazy (render_interval=20, chase off); ROSE_RENDER_HZ=10

warehouse_oldrender_5M_oldsock.provenance: camera_render_timing.md interpretation (live Isaac warehouse co-sim ~16.2 MHz; ~1.5x over camera-free 24.6 due to render)

dma.barrier_recovery_note: the grant->RSP_STALL barrier carries num_bytes=0 (pure control plane); DMA touches 0 ms of it. DMA value is on the ORTHOGONAL camera-frame payload-bandwidth axis (per-serve), not the per-grant barrier.

selftest.provenance: scratchpad/DMA_SELFTEST_PASS.txt (metasim ROSE dma=PASS reqrsp=PASS, 16 words [0]=0xc0de0000); DMA impl d5778bd
